name: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
summary: Reasoning-based candidate selection in small language models for entity disambiguation yields negligible in-domain gains but becomes decisive under true zero-shot domain shift, with reranker uncertainty and shift explaining when the paradigms disagree.
